description: Species 有兩個常見層次：一般『種類』和正式生物分類學『物種』。 這兩者不能混為一談。日常語境可以用 kind / type，但在 taxonomy 中 species 是特定分類層級；genus, family, population, breed 都不是同義詞。

options.explanation: Kind ✓ — means a general type or category and is common in everyday language. Here, the sentence is general and non-taxonomic. That makes Kind the most precise replacement for this particular use of species.

Type — means a category defined by shared features and is broader than formal species. This is broad and descriptive; it is too loose when formal taxonomy or species status is being tested. The decisive clue is that the sentence is general and non-taxonomic.

Biological species — means a formally recognised biological species in a scientific/taxonomic sense. This is the exact scientific concept and is too technical when the sentence only needs an everyday kind or broad grouping. The decisive clue is that the sentence is general and non-taxonomic.

Breed — means a domesticated variety within a species, usually produced through selective breeding. A breed is usually a domesticated subdivision within a species, so the taxonomic level is wrong. The decisive clue is that the sentence is general and non-taxonomic.
Genus — is a taxonomic rank above species. Genus is one rank above species and may contain several species. The decisive clue is that the sentence is general and non-taxonomic.

Population — means a group of individuals of a species in a particular area or breeding group. A population is a group of individuals, not the species category itself. The decisive clue is that the sentence is general and non-taxonomic.

options.explanation: Variety — can mean a general kind or a formal botanical variety, but it is not a general synonym for species. This can be a subtype or general kind, but it does not equal species and may denote a lower botanical rank. The decisive clue is that morphological variation rather than formal species difference is intended.

Biological species — means a formally recognised biological species in a scientific/taxonomic sense. This is the exact scientific concept and is too technical when the sentence only needs an everyday kind or broad grouping. The decisive clue is that morphological variation rather than formal species difference is intended.

Taxon — means a formally recognised unit at any rank in biological classification. This is an umbrella classification term and is too broad when the sentence specifically means species. The decisive clue is that morphological variation rather than formal species difference is intended.

Form ✓ — means a morphological, structural or ecological form rather than a formal species. Here, morphological variation rather than formal species difference is intended. That makes Form the most precise replacement for this particular use of species.

Breed — means a domesticated variety within a species, usually produced through selective breeding. A breed is usually a domesticated subdivision within a species, so the taxonomic level is wrong. The decisive clue is that morphological variation rather than formal species difference is intended.

Genus — is a taxonomic rank above species. Genus is one rank above species and may contain several species. The decisive clue is that morphological variation rather than formal species difference is intended.

falseSynonyms.zh: 品種 ≠ species breed 通常是同一物種內經人工選育形成的品種。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A breed is usually below the species level.

falseSynonyms.zh: 種族／品系 ≠ species race 在人類語境敏感，在生物學亦不是 species 的一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Race is not a standard synonym for species.

falseSynonyms.zh: 屬 ≠ species genus 是 species 之上的分類層級，可包含多個物種。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A genus contains one or more species.

falseSynonyms.zh: 科 ≠ species family 是比 genus 更高的分類層級。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Family is a higher taxonomic rank.

falseSynonyms.zh: 族群 ≠ species population 是同一地區或群體中的個體集合，可屬同一 species。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A population is a group of individuals, not the species category itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 變種／種類 ≠ 所有 species variety 有時是植物分類或一般種類詞，但不等於 species。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Variety is context-dependent and often below or outside species rank.

falseSynonyms.zh: 上位詞，不是一對一同義 taxon 可以是 species、genus、family 等任何分類單元。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Taxon is broader than species.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形陷阱 species 單複數同形；specie 通常指硬幣／現金形式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Species is both singular and plural.
